description:
£135 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the student lettings market this spacious five bedroom maisonette, situated on the ever-popular Grosvenor Gardens in Jesmond Vale, NE2.

Located on a popular student street, the property benefits from an excellent position, with easy access to Osborne Road, the beautiful Jesmond Dene and a fantastic range of local amenities. Newcastle City Centre is also within easy reach, whether travelling on foot or by public transport.

This converted upper maisonette offers generous accommodation throughout, comprising a central living room, a separate galley-style kitchen, five well-proportioned double bedrooms and two family bathrooms. The property also benefits from access to a private rear yard.

With its spacious layout and sought-after location, this property is an excellent choice for students looking to enjoy everything Jesmond has to offer.

Interested in viewing? Contact My Property Box today and speak to our lettings team to arrange your viewing!
